CoreProduct.Title: Our Core Product
CoreProduct.Name: Sawaed Elm
CoreProduct.Tagline: The all-in-one mobile platform connecting students, parents, teachers, administrators, and drivers — on Android, iOS, and Web. One app. Every role. Every school.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Academic Management
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Assignments, exams & weekly plans — teachers create, students submit, parents stay informed. Automated reminders and grade tracking built in.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Smart Social Feed
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Posts, reels & polls in a safe, school-only space. Privacy by design — zero content exposure outside the platform.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Direct Messaging
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Secure one-to-one chat for every school role. Smart reminders auto-follow unread messages so nothing falls through the cracks.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Real-Time Notifications
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Targeted push alerts for every event — absences, submissions, payments, bus arrivals. Smart scheduling, zero notification fatigue.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Attendance & Leave
CoreProduct.Features.Description: One-tap digital attendance with automatic holiday integration. Parents are notified the instant their child is marked absent or late.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Finance & Payments
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Structured instalment plans, automatic reminders, and real-time payment status for every family. No spreadsheets. No missed fees.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Transportation Tracking
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Live journey management for drivers, real-time drop-off confirmations for parents, and emergency alerts for the whole school community.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Sawaed AI Tutor
CoreProduct.Features.Description: A built-in AI study companion personalised to each student's name, grade, and language — available 24/7. Powered by permanently free AI models.

Sawaed.Hero.Subtitle: A company specialized in software development, hardware integration, and mobile app design. We transform ideas into advanced digital solutions that empower businesses to thrive in the modern technology landscape.
School.Intro.Title: One Platform, Every Part of School Life
School.Intro.Description: Sawaed Elm brings every part of school life into a single, easy-to-use mobile and web experience: learning, communication, attendance, fees, transport, and school life — all in one place, secured and available in Arabic, English, and French — with support for any language the school requests.
School.Intro.Highlight1: A private, school-only social network — the engagement of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and WhatsApp, all combined in one safe educational space inside your school. No strangers, no ads, no unethical or illegal content — just a protected environment where children benefit from social media without the risks.
School.Intro.Highlight2: Sawaed AI — a personal AI assistant that actually knows each student's real school data and answers accordingly.
School.Intro.HighlightNote: These are not add-ons. They are why families open the app every day.
School.Intro.Highlight3: Your school's own branded app on the App Store and Google Play — verified, trusted, and yours.
School.Branding.SchoolName.Assf: Academy And Schools Of Scientific Fortune
School.Branding.Title: Your School's Own App — Branded, Verified, and Yours
School.Branding.Lead: Sawaed Elm gives your school its own dedicated app, published on the App Store and Google Play under your school's name. Parents and students download it just like any other app — searching for your school by name. This is not a shared platform hidden behind someone else's brand. It is your school's app, with your logo, your colors, and your identity.
School.Branding.AppStore.Title: Published on App Store & Google Play
School.Branding.AppStore.Item1: Your school's app is listed on both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store under your school's name.
School.Branding.AppStore.Item2: Parents and students find it by searching for your school — just like any popular app.
School.Branding.AppStore.Item3: Your school's logo, name, and branding appear on the store listing, not ours.
School.Branding.Verified.Title: Tested & Verified by Apple and Google
School.Branding.Verified.Item1: The app passes Apple's strict App Store review process — confirming it is safe, functional, and free of harmful code.
School.Branding.Verified.Item2: Google Play's security review verifies the app is free of malware, backdoors, and illegal access — your data stays yours.
School.Branding.Verified.Item3: Both platforms enforce data privacy standards, so your school community's information is protected by world-class security.
School.Branding.Marketing.Title: Powerful Marketing for Your School
School.Branding.Marketing.Item1: Having your own app on the App Store and Google Play is a statement — it tells families your school is modern, forward-thinking, and invested in technology.
School.Branding.Marketing.Item2: Parents share the app with friends and relatives — every download is free advertising for your school.
School.Branding.Marketing.Item3: Your school stands out from competitors who still rely on WhatsApp groups, Facebook pages, and paper notices.
School.Branding.Data.Title: Your School Owns Its Data
School.Branding.Data.Item1: All school data — students, parents, staff, grades, payments — belongs to your school, not to us.
School.Branding.Data.Item2: No hidden access, no secret backdoors. Only authorized school administrators can access the data, with full audit logs.
School.Branding.Data.Item3: You can export or request your data at any time. Your school is always in control.
School.Branding.Result: A verified, branded app on the world's two largest app stores is more than a tool — it is a trust signal, a marketing asset, and a competitive advantage that no traditional school software can match.
School.Social.Title: The School Social Network
School.Social.Lead: Today's students and parents live on social media — Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, WhatsApp, and more. Sawaed Elm combines the best of all of them into one safe, school-only space: the feed, the stories, the reels, the reactions — but with no strangers, no ads, no unwanted content, and no exposure to anything illegal or unethical. A protected educational environment where children enjoy the benefits of social media without the risks.
School.Social.Feed.Title: A Living School Feed
School.Social.Feed.Item1: A dynamic feed of posts from teachers, staff, and the school — photos, videos, and text.
School.Social.Feed.Item2: Reactions — students and parents react to celebrate achievements, events, and announcements.
School.Social.Feed.Item3: Comments — real conversation around school moments, in a moderated, school-only space.
School.Social.Stories.Title: Stories & Reels
School.Social.Stories.Item1: Statuses (Stories) — short, auto-expiring updates, exactly like the stories families use every day.
School.Social.Stories.Item2: Reels — short-form school videos for events, sports days, performances, and celebrations.
School.Social.Stories.Item3: Seen-by / Viewers — authors can see who has viewed a post or reel.
School.Social.Engagement.Title: Polls & Engagement
School.Social.Engagement.Item1: Polls — ask the community a question and get instant results: trip preferences, event dates, feedback.
School.Social.Engagement.Item2: Everything drives two-way engagement instead of one-way announcements.
School.Social.Targeting.Title: Smart, Safe Audience Targeting
School.Social.Targeting.Item1: Whole school, staff only, or students & parents.
School.Social.Targeting.Item2: A specific grade or even a single class/section.
School.Social.Targeting.Item3: A Grade 3 teacher's message reaches Grade 3 families — and no one else.
School.Social.Safety.Title: Safe by Design
School.Social.Safety.Item1: School-only. No outsiders, no public internet exposure — a closed community.
School.Social.Safety.Item2: Moderated. Staff control what's posted and can remove content; students can be blocked from posting when needed.
School.Social.Safety.Item3: Rich media, delivered fast. Photos and videos stream quickly and securely worldwide through a global CDN.
School.Social.Result: Parents and students check the app the way they check social media — daily, willingly, and often. That engagement is something no traditional school system can match.
School.AI.Title: Sawaed AI, the Assistant That Knows the Student
School.AI.Lead: Every school app now claims to have AI. They all do the same thing: a generic chatbot that answers general questions. Sawaed AI is fundamentally different. It is connected to the school's real data, so it answers about this student — securely, personally, and instantly.
School.AI.Questions.Title: It Answers Real Questions About the Real Student
School.AI.Questions.Q1: "How many days has my son been absent this term?"
School.AI.Questions.Q2: "What homework does my daughter have this week?"
School.AI.Questions.Q3: "How is my child doing academically overall?"
School.AI.Questions.Q4: "What school fees are still unpaid, and when are they due?"
School.AI.Questions.Q5: "What events or exams are coming up for my child?"
School.AI.Questions.Note: …and Sawaed AI looks up the actual answer from the school's system and replies — no digging through menus, no calling the office.
School.AI.Data.Title: Powered by Real, Permission-Aware Data
School.AI.Data.Item1: The parent's linked children — it knows exactly who is being asked about.
School.AI.Data.Item2: Attendance — days attended, absences, sick days, leave.
School.AI.Data.Item3: Assignments & homework — what's due, for the right class.
School.AI.Data.Item4: Academic summary — the student's overall picture in one answer.
School.AI.Data.Item5: Fees & installments — amounts, due dates, what's paid and outstanding.
School.AI.Data.Item6: Upcoming events & exams — relevant to that specific student.
School.AI.Data.Item7: App help guide — "how do I…?" questions answered from within the app.
School.AI.Privacy.Title: Private and Permission-Respecting
School.AI.Privacy.Item1: Sawaed AI only ever sees what the user is allowed to see — a parent gets their own children's data, never another family's.
School.AI.Privacy.Item2: Every request is scoped to the school and the signed-in user's permissions.
School.AI.Privacy.Item3: Answers are role-aware: a parent, a student, and a teacher each get responses suited to them.
School.AI.Availability.Title: Always Available, in Multiple Languages
School.AI.Availability.Item1: Available 24/7 — no waiting for office hours.
School.AI.Availability.Item2: Fully trilingual Arabic, English, and French — and any language the school requests.
School.AI.Result: The front office stops fielding the same phone calls. Parents get instant, accurate, personal answers. It's the difference between a chatbot and a real assistant — and no competitor offers it.
School.FeatureFlags.Title: Feature Flags — Your School, Your Modules
School.FeatureFlags.Lead: Not every school needs every module. Some schools want transport tracking but not the social feed. Others want everything except finance. With Feature Flags, the school's administrators can enable or disable any module — instantly, without code changes or waiting for a developer. The app adapts to what your school actually uses.
School.FeatureFlags.HowItWorks.Title: How It Works
School.FeatureFlags.HowItWorks.Item1: Each module — social feed, messaging, attendance, finance, transport, AI, and more — can be toggled on or off from the admin dashboard.
School.FeatureFlags.HowItWorks.Item2: Disabled modules disappear from the app entirely — students and parents only see what the school has enabled.
School.FeatureFlags.HowItWorks.Item3: Changes take effect immediately — no app update, no downtime, no developer involved.
School.FeatureFlags.HowItWorks.Item4: Modules can be re-enabled at any time, so a school can start lean and expand as needs grow.
School.FeatureFlags.Modules.Title: Toggleable Modules
School.FeatureFlags.Modules.Item1: Social feed, stories & reels — enable or disable the school social network.
School.FeatureFlags.Modules.Item2: Sawaed AI — turn the AI assistant on or off per school.
School.FeatureFlags.Modules.Item3: Finance & payments — disable if the school handles fees outside the platform.
School.FeatureFlags.Modules.Item4: Transportation tracking — disable if the school has no bus service.
School.FeatureFlags.Modules.Item5: Attendance, messaging, academics, and more — each independently controlled.
School.FeatureFlags.Benefits.Title: Why Schools Love It
School.FeatureFlags.Benefits.Item1: Pay only for what you use — disabled modules don't clutter the app or the bill.
School.FeatureFlags.Benefits.Item2: A clean, focused experience — families see only the features their school chose for them.
School.FeatureFlags.Benefits.Item3: Start small and grow — enable new modules when the school is ready, with zero migration.
School.FeatureFlags.Control.Title: Full Administrative Control
School.FeatureFlags.Control.Item1: Only authorized administrators can toggle modules — changes are logged in the audit trail.
School.FeatureFlags.Control.Item2: Module visibility is enforced at the API level — no backdoor access to disabled features.
School.FeatureFlags.Control.Item3: Schools can request custom modules — if a school needs something we don't have yet, we build it and flag it on.
School.FeatureFlags.Result: The school gets exactly the platform it wants — no more, no less. Every module is a conscious choice, not a forced bundle. That is what it means to own your school's app.
School.CatalogLead: Alongside the two flagship features, Sawaed Elm is a full school operating system — built for five roles: Students, Parents, Teachers, Administrators, and Drivers — each with a home screen made for them.

School.Catalog.title: Learning & Academics
items: Courses in Arabic, English, and French, organized by grade and section.
Teaching assignments — assign staff to each course; reassigning moves access instantly.
Assignments & homework — teachers create, publish, and target homework to the class.
Submissions & grading — students submit in-app; teachers grade and return results.
Exams — schedule exams with date, time, and total marks; parents and students see what's coming.
Grades — enter grades and give every student and parent a private view of their results.
Weekly plans — teachers publish the week's lesson plan.
Timetables & class sessions — the daily schedule, per class and per student.
Academic structure — grades, classes, sections, and subjects.

School.Catalog.title: Attendance & Leave
items: Fast daily attendance — teachers mark a whole class in seconds.
Real-time parent alerts — the moment a child is marked absent, the family knows.
Student attendance summary — days present, absent, sick, and on leave.
Attendance reports — per-student and school-wide reports.
Digital leave requests — parents request leave in-app; staff approve or decline with one tap.
Staff attendance — the school tracks employee attendance the same clean way.

School.Catalog.title: Communication
items: Family–school messaging — secure, private conversations with read receipts and unread counts.
Inbox — every conversation in one organized place.
Push notifications — instant alerts for absences, grades, messages, fees, events, and announcements.
Notification preferences — each user controls exactly what they're notified about.

School.Catalog.title: Finance & Payments
items: Flexible fee plans — split total fees into installments, applied per year, grade, or section.
Pay monthly, yearly, or several months at once — one payment can cover multiple installments.
Automatic installment status — Paid, Partially Paid, Remaining, or Overdue, calculated in real time.
Record real-world payments in seconds — auto-generated invoices with reference numbers.
Approval workflow — payments start as pending and only count once an authorized manager approves.
School-defined payment methods — cash, bank transfer, or any method the school configures.
Family payment view — total fees, paid, remaining, and overdue at a glance.
Management payment dashboard — expected vs. collected, filterable by year, grade, section, and status.
Full financial audit trail — every payment and status change is recorded and never deleted.

School.Catalog.title: Transportation & Safety
items: Live bus tracking — parents watch the bus move on the map in real time.
Per-student pickup & drop-off status — confirmed picked up / dropped off / no-show for each child.
Driver journey view — drivers run the route, mark each student, and start/complete the trip.
Urgent notifications — a driver can alert the school and families instantly.
Route & bus management — buses, routes, and dispatch managed centrally.

School.Catalog.title: School Life
items: Shared calendar & events — a single school calendar everyone can see and add to.
Holidays & weekend configuration — the official school year, reflected everywhere.
Registration — onboard new students and families into the platform.
Profiles & directories — student, teacher, and colleague profiles; a staff directory.
Self-service profile — users update their photo, bio, and phone; sensitive changes go through approval.

School.Catalog.title: Administration & Control
items: User management — manage students, parents, and employees from one place.
Roles & permissions — fine-grained control with custom roles; every sensitive action is gated at the API.
Course & teaching-scope management — create and assign staff to trilingual courses; every change is audited.
Parent–child links — connect each parent to exactly the right children.
Approval workflows — name-change, birth-date-change, and payment approvals.
Analytics & reports — school statistics, dashboards, and exportable reports.
Audit & history — a full record of who did what, for accountability and trust.
Moderation — remove content and block misuse to keep the community safe.

School.Catalog.title: Built-in Foundations
items: iOS, Android, and Web from one codebase.
Full Arabic, English, and French, with right-to-left support done properly — and any language the school requests.
Dark mode across the entire app.
White-label branding — ship as your school's own branded app.
Bank-grade security — token-based sign-in, permission-scoped data, and time-limited secure media links.
Global content delivery — photos and video load fast anywhere in the world.

School.ProblemsTitle: The Real Problems Sawaed Elm Solves

School.Problems.problem: Parents are in the dark about attendance, grades, homework, and fees until a problem is already big.
School.Problems.solution: One app gives every parent a live, honest view of their own child — and Sawaed AI answers their questions instantly.

School.Problems.problem: Communication is scattered across WhatsApp groups, Facebook pages, paper slips, and phone calls — messages get lost, and there's no privacy.
School.Problems.solution: One secure, school-only channel: targeted posts, private messaging, and push notifications that actually reach people.

School.Problems.problem: The front office drowns in repetitive calls — "was my son absent?", "what fees are due?", "when is the exam?"
School.Problems.solution: Self-service answers plus a data-aware AI assistant handle these 24/7, freeing staff for real work.

School.Problems.problem: Low parent engagement — traditional school apps get opened only when there's a problem.
School.Problems.solution: A safe, school-only social feed with stories and reels makes families want to open the app every day.

School.Problems.problem: Attendance is paper-based and slow, and parents find out about absences far too late.
School.Problems.solution: Digital attendance in seconds, with instant absence alerts to parents.

School.Problems.problem: Fee collection is chaotic — lost invoices, awkward reminders, unclear balances, and no record of who approved what.
School.Problems.solution: Clear digital fee plans, one payment covering several months, an approval step before money counts, auto-generated invoices, transparent balances, and a permanent audit trail.

School.Problems.problem: Bus safety causes daily anxiety — parents don't know where the bus is or whether their child got on.
School.Problems.solution: Live GPS tracking and per-child pickup/drop-off confirmation.

School.Problems.problem: Schools pay for 4+ separate tools (LMS, messaging, payments, transport) that don't talk to each other.
School.Problems.solution: One unified platform replaces the stack — one login, one source of truth.

School.Problems.problem: Language barriers exclude part of the community.
School.Problems.solution: Fully trilingual Arabic, English, and French — and any language the school requests, everywhere.

School.Problems.problem: Public social media is unsafe for a school community — strangers, ads, and no control.
School.Problems.solution: A closed, moderated, school-only network with no outside exposure.

School.BenefitsTitle: The Benefits — for Everyone in the School

School.Benefits.title: Parents
School.Benefits.text: Peace of mind and transparency: real answers about their child in seconds, in their own language, without calling the office.

School.Benefits.title: Students
School.Benefits.text: A school life that feels modern — a feed, reels, and an AI assistant — plus clear visibility of homework, grades, and schedule.

School.Benefits.title: Teachers
School.Benefits.text: Save hours every week: attendance in seconds, homework and grading in-app, and fewer interruptions from repetitive parent questions.

School.Benefits.title: Administrators
School.Benefits.text: Control and insight: analytics, reports, roles, approvals, and an audit trail — the whole school in one dashboard.

School.Benefits.title: Drivers
School.Benefits.text: A purpose-built route screen with per-student check-off and a direct line to the school.

School.Benefits.title: School Leaders
School.Benefits.text: A stronger brand, higher family satisfaction and retention, lower software costs, and a genuine competitive edge.
